Acme API Reference

The Acme API lets you manage widgets programmatically. All requests use JSON over HTTPS.

Authentication

Authenticate every request with a bearer token in the Authorization header. Tokens are created in the dashboard and can be scoped to read or write access. Rotate tokens regularly.

Widgets

Create, list, update and delete widgets. Widgets have a name, a color, and an owner. The list endpoint is paginated with cursor-based pagination.

# not a heading — this is a code comment
curl https://api.acme.dev/v1/widgets

Rate limits

The API allows 100 requests per second per token. Exceeding the rate limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Rate limits are higher on enterprise plans.
